settled.lesson: 17 recommendations: 0 target, 9 stop, 8 squared off; -0.9R in total. Best: BANKNIFTY CE  at 09:41 (+3.4R, ran 603 pts in favour). Worst: NIFTY CE  at 11:16 (-1.0R). 4 squared-off trades reached 2R during the day and gave part of it back - the rules hold to 15:15 by design; the backtest says trailing earlier did not help. India VIX was 15.3 at the open - the band where the rules did best historically (50-75th percentile) is roughly 13-16. 2 of 2 high-score (3+) ideas ended positive. Carry forward: one trade per rule per day, the index-level stop decides, premium paths are shown so you can see where the plan and the option diverged.
